title: Investor Update Call — Northwind Ventures
description: Quarterly metrics walkthrough with Northwind's partners.
transcript: 00:04 Vishesh Gupta: Hi Krish, hi Meera — thanks for the time. I'll walk through the Q3 numbers, then the roadmap, and then open it up for questions. Should take about 20 minutes of content.
00:22 Krish Menon: Perfect, let's dive in. I've been looking forward to this one.

00:27 Vishesh Gupta: So the headline numbers. We closed the quarter at $2.4 million in ARR, which is 18% quarter-over-quarter growth. Churn came in at 2.1%, down from 2.8% last quarter, and net revenue retention is 112%.
00:51 Meera Nair: That NRR number is excellent. What's driving it — expansion within teams, or new use cases?

00:59 Vishesh Gupta: Mostly expansion. Seat growth within existing accounts is running at about 40% of new bookings. The enterprise tier we launched in July is contributing too — eight enterprise logos this quarter, including two of the Fortune 1000 names from our pipeline.
01:20 Krish Menon: Eight enterprise logos in the first full quarter of the tier — that's ahead of the plan we discussed in June, right?
01:29 Vishesh Gupta: Correct — we had planned for five to six, so we're roughly 40% ahead on enterprise acquisition.
01:37 Meera Nair: How's the enterprise motion affecting the pipeline timeline? Enterprise cycles are longer — are you seeing that?
01:46 Vishesh Gupta: We are — enterprise cycles average 45 days versus 12 days for the self-serve tier, but the ACV is roughly 20 times higher, so the math still favors it strongly.
02:02 Krish Menon: Let's talk burn. What are we at now?

02:07 Vishesh Gupta: Net burn is $180,000 a month, which gives us about 14 months of runway at the current pace. With the Q4 plan, we'd project 11 months, but the board-approved hiring plan adds six roles in January, which brings it back to about 10.
02:30 Meera Nair: Are you comfortable with 10 months? That's getting close to the zone where you want to be raising, not recruiting.
02:38 Vishesh Gupta: That's exactly why we're starting seed-extension conversations in Q1. With the current metrics — 18% growth and 112% NRR — we'd be raising from strength, not need.
02:53 Krish Menon: Agreed. For what it's worth, the Q3 numbers would put you in the top quartile of our portfolio for this stage.

03:02 Vishesh Gupta: That's good to hear. Let me walk through the roadmap, then — the three priorities for Q4 are the mobile app, the conversation intelligence suite, and the enterprise admin controls.
03:18 Meera Nair: Which of those three do you think moves the revenue needle most?
03:24 Vishesh Gupta: Honestly, the admin controls. They unlock two enterprise deals currently stalled on security review — combined ACV of about $240,000 a year.
03:38 Meera Nair: That's a compelling reason to prioritize them. What's the timeline?
03:44 Vishesh Gupta: Engineering says 90 days, so we're targeting GA by end of January, with beta in December for the two stalled accounts.
03:56 Krish Menon: Before we run out of time — headcount. Where are we?
04:01 Vishesh Gupta: We're at 22 today, ending the year at 24, then the six January roles take us to 30 by end of Q1. The plan stays inside the burn envelope we just discussed.
04:17 Meera Nair: And the team composition — any change in the ratio?
04:22 Vishesh Gupta: Slightly heavier on engineering this cycle — four of the six January roles are engineers, one is product design, one is enterprise sales.
04:35 Krish Menon: Makes sense given the roadmap. Okay, I think we have what we need for the partner meeting on Monday. Can you send the metric pack by Thursday?
04:46 Vishesh Gupta: Will do — I'll send the full metric pack, including the cohort breakdowns, by Thursday.
04:53 Meera Nair: One more request — can you include the enterprise pipeline detail? The two stalled deals, specifically.
05:01 Vishesh Gupta: Sure — I'll anonymize the account names but include the deal sizes and the blockers, which is the useful part anyway.
05:10 Meera Nair: Perfect. Thanks Vishesh, this was a great quarter.
05:15 Krish Menon: Agreed. Talk at the next quarterly, or sooner if anything material changes.
05:22 Vishesh Gupta: Will do. Thanks both — have a great week!

summary.overview: Quarterly investor update to Northwind Ventures. Q3 closed at $2.4M ARR (+18% QoQ), churn improved to 2.1% (from 2.8%), NRR at 112%, and 8 enterprise logos (vs. 5–6 planned). Net burn is $180k/month — ~14 months runway, ~10 months after January hiring. Seed-extension conversations planned for Q1 to raise from strength. Q4 priorities: mobile app, conversation intelligence, enterprise admin controls (unblocking ~$240k ACV in stalled deals, GA end of January). Headcount 22 → 30 by end of Q1. Deliverables: full metric pack (incl. anonymized enterprise pipeline detail) by Thursday.
